items.title: Flags Explorer redesigned for easier override sharing
items.summary: is a tool in the Vercel Toolbar where you can see which feature flags are active on your end, and share them with your team, either by setting them for the branch or through a URL.Flags ExplorerThe Explorer surface has been redesigned to co-locate overrides, branch recommendations, and any related actions.Whenever a branch has overrides set, they will be recommended to teammates visiting the deployment through a dialog.Flags Explorer is available on all plans.
